title: Read-only impersonation 403s on read-only POST endpoints; allowlist the exact action, never the prefix
answers: support staff impersonating get 403 impersonation_read_only on a POST endpoint
audience count / blast radius never loads while impersonating
how do I let a read-only impersonation session call a POST that only reads
why does the workflow builder fail during read-only impersonation
body:
Symptom: during a read-only impersonation session a feature that reads through a POST (filters in the body, e.g. workflow audience sizing `hog_flows/user_blast_radius`) never loads, and the request fails with `403 impersonation_read_only`.
Root cause: posthog/middleware.py:ImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware rejects every non-idempotent method before the viewset runs, so the viewset's own permissions/scopes never get a say. It is fail-closed and only lets through entries in posthog/middleware.py:READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS.
Fix pattern: first confirm the action writes nothing (trace its helpers). Then add one `("POST", re.compile(r"^/api/(environments|projects)/([0-9]+|@current)/<prefix>/<action>/?$"))` entry with a comment saying why it only reads. Name the exact action(s), because prefixes like `hog_flows/` and `logs/` also host writing actions (publish, run, bulk_delete, CRUD). The `environments` alternative follows the other entries' style. EnvironmentsRewriteMiddleware rewrites the path to `/api/projects/...` anyway.
Constraints: never allowlist an endpoint that spends a token or dispatches work (e.g. hog_flows `run`, `batch_jobs`). Add the allowed path to posthog/test/test_middleware.py:TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware.test_read_only_impersonation_allows_allowlisted_post. Add writing siblings under the same prefix to test_read_only_impersonation_blocks_mutating_siblings, so a later edit that widens the regex fails CI. Changing how the middleware decides "read-only" (e.g. having it ask the viewset) is a platform change that needs its own security-reviewed PR. As of this PR, `POST feature_flags/user_blast_radius` was still blocked; sibling PR #105805 handles it.
applies: Any POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE endpoint that must work during read-only impersonation (posthog/middleware.py allowlist)
